name: production-2026-09
note: Observation shape from Q6, per-device row counts from Q3. Key counts are a median and 95th percentile; catchment volumes are a median, 90th and 99th, interpolated rather than fitted because program encounters are not one population.

catchment_rows_per_user.note: Q3, from each user's most recent sync. A 370x spread between the median device and the 99th percentile. Reproduce the tail: a generator giving every user a typical catchment produces no heavy syncs, and the heavy tail is where the choke points are.

temporal_spread.note: NOT MEASURED. No production query covers the age distribution of last_modified_date_time -- see Q14. Section H3 warns that getting this wrong invalidates every incremental scenario: rows sharing one timestamp make incremental sync return either everything or nothing. The values below are a placeholder chosen to be obviously a guess, and a run using them should say so.
